title: Ninja Run
description:
Run jump slide and battle your way to a high score in Ninja Run by CooperAce Productions



-Play as a ninja who can run jump slide and throw ninja stars



-Classic side scrolling endless runner



-Battle against a huge and terrifying boss



-Randomised level generation



-Optional difficulty - easy medium and hard



-Heaps of obstacles and traps to dodge! such as saw-blades, spinning axes, bombs and missiles! 



-Choice of background - volcano - graveyard - winter



-Track your high score



-Enjoy endless hours of unlimited ninja running! 



-Captivating soundtrack by Kevin Macleod



-Designed and created by CooperAce Productions
description_short: Run jump slide and battle your way to a high score in Ninja Run by CooperAce Productions
